yattatrādyaṃ padamaviratānuttarajñaptirūpaṃ / tannirṇetuṃ prakaraṇamidamārabhe@haṃ dvitīyam anupāyaṃ hi yadrūpaṃ ko@rtho deśanayātra vai / sakṛtsyāddeśanā paścādanupāyatvamucyayate anupāyamidaṃ tattvamityupāyaṃ vinā kutaḥ / svayaṃ tu teṣāṃ tattādṛk kiṃ brūmaḥ kila tānprati yaccaturdhoditaṃ rūpaṃ vijñānasya vibhorasau / svabhāva eva mantavyaḥ sa hi nityodito vibhuḥ etāvadbhirasaṃkhyātaiḥ svabhāvairyatprakāśate / ke@pyaṃśāṃśikayā tena viśantyanye niraṃśataḥ tatrāpi cābhyupāyādisāpekṣānyatvayogataḥ / upāyasyāpi no vāryā tadanyatvādvicitratā tatra ye nirmalātmāno bhairavīyāṃ svasaṃvidam / nirupāyāmupāsīnāstadvidhiḥ praṇigadyate tatra tāvatkriyāyogo nābhyupāyatvamarhati / sa hi tasmātsamudbhūtaḥ pratyuta pravibhāvyate jñaptāvupāya eva syāditi cejjñaptirucyate / prakāśatvaṃ svaprakāśe tacca tatrānyataḥ katham saṃvittattvaṃ svaprakāśamityasminkaṃ nu yuktibhiḥ / tadabhāve bhavedviśvaṃ jaḍatvādaprakāśakam

[and]-:C3 śrītantrālokasya tṛtīyamāhnikam atha paraupayikaṃ praṇigadyate padamanuttarameva maheśituḥ prakāśamātraṃ yatproktaṃ bhairavīyaṃ paraṃ mahaḥ / tatra svatantratāmātramadhikaṃ pravivicyate yaḥ prakāśaḥ sa sarvasya prakāśatvaṃ prayacchati / na ca tadvyatirekyasti viśvaṃ sadvāvabhāsate ato@sau parameśānaḥ svātmavyomanyanargalaḥ / iyataḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḍambarasya pradarśakaḥ nirmale makure yadvadbhānti bhūmijalādayaḥ / amiśrāstadvadekasmiṃścinnāthe viśvavṛttayaḥ sadṛśaṃ bhāti nayanadarpaṇāmbaravāriṣu / tathā hi nirmale rūpe rūpamevāvabhāsate pracchannarāgiṇī kāntapratibimbitasundaram / darpaṇaṃ kucakumbhābhyāṃ spṛśantyapi na tṛpyati na hi sparśo@sya vimalo rūpameva tathā yataḥ / nairmalyaṃ cātiniviḍasajātīyaikasaṃgatiḥ svasminnabhedādbhinnasya darśanakṣamataiva yā / atyaktasvaprakāśasya nairmalyaṃ tadgurūditam nairmalyaṃ mukhyamekasya saṃvinnāthasya sarvataḥ / aṃśāṃśikātaḥ kvāpyanyadvimalaṃ tattadicchayā

[and]-:C4 atha śrītantrāloke caturthamāhnikam atha śāktamupāyamaṇḍalaṃ kathayāmaḥ paramātmasaṃvide anantarāhnikokte@sminsvabhāve pārameśvare / pravivikṣurvikalpasya kuryātsaṃskāramañjasā vikalpaḥ saṃskṛtaḥ sūte vikalpaṃ svātmasaṃskṛtam / svatulyaṃ so@pi so@pyanyaṃ so@pyanyaṃ sadṛśātmakam caturṣveva vikalpeṣu yaḥ saṃskāraḥ kramādasau / asphuṭaḥ sphuṭatābhāvī prasphuṭansphuṭitātmakaḥ tataḥ sphuṭataro yāvadante sphuṭatamo bhavet / asphuṭādau vikalpe ca bhedo@pyastyāntarālikaḥ tataḥ sphuṭatamodāratādrūpyaparivṛṃhitā / saṃvidabhyeti vimalāmavikalpasvarūpatām ataśca bhairavīyaṃ yattejaḥ saṃvitsvabhāvakam / bhūyo bhūyo vimṛśatāṃ jāyate tatsphuṭātmatā nanu saṃvitparāmraṣṭrī parāmarśamayī svataḥ / parāmṛśyā kathaṃ tāthārūpyasṛṣṭau tu sā jaḍā ucyate svātmasaṃvittiḥ svabhāvādeva nirbharā / nāsyāmapāsyaṃ nādheyaṃ kiṃcidityuditaṃ purā kiṃ tu durghaṭakāritvātsvācchandyānnirmalādasau / svātmapracchādanakrīḍāpaṇḍitaḥ parameśvaraḥ

[and]-:C5 atha śrītantrāloke pañcamamāhnikam āṇavena vidhinā paradhāma prepsatāmatha nirūpyata etat vikalpasyaiva saṃskāre jāte niṣpratiyogini / abhīṣṭe vastuni prāptirniścitā bhogamokṣayoḥ vikalpaḥ kasyacitsvātmasvātantryādeva susthiraḥ / upāyāntarasāpekṣyaviyogenaiva jāyate kasyacittu vikalpo@sau svātmasaṃskaraṇaṃ prati / upāyāntarasāpekṣastatroktaḥ pūrvako vidhiḥ vikalpo nāma cinmātrasvabhāvo yadyapi sthitaḥ / tathāpi niścayātmāsāvaṇoḥ svātantryayojakaḥ niścayo bahudhā caiṣa tatropāyāśca bhedinaḥ / aṇuśabdena te coktā dūrāntikavibhedataḥ tatra buddhau tathā prāṇe dehe cāpi pramātari / apāramārthike@pyasmin paramārthaḥ prakāśate yataḥ prakāśāccinmātrāt prāṇādyavyatirekavat / tasyaiva tu svatantratvāddviguṇaṃ jaḍacidvapuḥ uktaṃ traiśirase caitaddevyai candrārdhamaulinā / jīvaḥ śaktiḥ śivasyaiva sarvatraiva sthitāpi sā svarūpapratyaye rūḍhā jñānasyonmīlanātparā / tasya cidrūpatāṃ satyāṃ svātantryollāsakalpanāt

[and]-:C6 atha śrītantrāloke sthānaprakalpākhyatayā sphuṭastu bāhyo@bhyupāyaḥ pravivicyate@tha sthānabhedastridhā proktaḥ prāṇe dehe bahistathā / prāṇaśca pañcadhā dehe dvidhā bāhyāntaratvataḥ maṇḍalaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ pātramakṣasūtraṃ sapustakam / liṅgaṃ tūraṃ paṭaḥ pustaṃ pratimā mūrtireva ca ityekādaśadhā bāhyaṃ punastadbahudhā bhavet / tatra prāṇāśrayaṃ tāvadvidhānamupadiśyate adhvā samasta evāyaṃ ṣaḍvidho@pyativistṛtaḥ / yo vakṣyate sa ekatra prāṇe tāvatpratiṣṭhitaḥ adhvanaḥ kalanaṃ yattatkramākramatayā sthitam / kramākramau hi citraikakalanā bhāvagocare kramākramātmā kālaśca paraḥ saṃvidi vartate / kālī nāma parā śaktiḥ saiva devasya gīyate saiva saṃvidbahiḥ svātmagarbhībhūtau kramākramau / sphuṭayantī prarohaṇa prāṇavṛttiriti sthitā saṃvinmātraṃ hi yacchuddhaṃ prakāśaparamārthakam / tanmeyamātmanaḥ projjhya viviktaṃ bhāsate nabhaḥ tadeva śūnyarūpatvaṃ saṃvidaḥ parigīyate / neti neti vimarśena yogināṃ sā parā daśā

atha paramarahasyo@yaṃ cakrāṇāṃ bhaṇyate@bhyudayaḥ // 1b ityayatnajamākhyātaṃ yatnajaṃ tu nigadyate / bījapiṇḍātmakaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvidaḥ spandanātmatām vidadhatparasaṃvittāvupāya iti varṇitam / yathāraghaṭṭacakrāgraghaṭīyantraughavāhanam ekānusaṃdhiyatnena citraṃ yantrodayaṃ bhajet / ekānusaṃdhānabalājjāte mantrodaye@niśam tanmantradevatā yatnāttādātmyena prasīdati / khe rasaikākṣi nityotthe tadardhaṃ dvikapiṇḍake trike sapta sahasrāṇi dviśatītyudayo mataḥ / catuṣke tu sahasrāṇi pañca caiva catuḥśatī pañcārṇe@bdhisahasrāṇi triśatī viṃśatistathā / ṣaṭke sahasratritayaṃ ṣaṭśatī codayo bhavet saptake trisahasraṃ tu ṣaḍaśītyadhikaṃ smṛtam / śataistu saptaviṃśatyā varṇāṣṭakavikalpite caturviṃśatiśatyā tu navārṇeṣūdayo bhavet / adhiṣaṣṭyekaviṃśatyā śatānāṃ daśavarṇake ekānnaviṃśatiśataṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ śivārṇake / aṣṭādaśa śatāni syurudayo dvādaśārṇake

[and]-:C8 atha śītantrāloke aṣṭamamāhnikaṃ deśādhvano@pyatha samāsavikāsayogātsaṃgīyate vidhirayaṃ śivaśāstradṛṣṭaḥ vicārito@yaṃ kālādhvā kriyāśaktimayaḥ prabhoḥ / mūrtivaicitryajastajjo deśādhvātha nirūpyate adhvā samasta evāyaṃ cinmātre saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ / yattatra nahi viśrāntaṃ tannabhaḥkusumāyate saṃviddvāreṇa tatsṛṣṭe śūnye dhiyi marutsu ca / nāḍīcakrānucakreṣu barhirdehe@dhvasaṃsthitiḥ tatrādhvaivaṃ nirūpyo@yaṃ yatastatprakriyākramam / anusaṃdadhadeva drāg yogī bhairavatāṃ vrajet didṛkṣayaiva sarvārthān yadā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate / tadā kiṃ bahunoktena ityuktaṃ spandaśāsane jñātvā samastamadhvānaṃ tadīśeṣu vilāpayet / tān dehaprāṇadhīcakre pūrvavad gālayetkramāt tatsamastaṃ svasaṃvittau sā saṃvidbharitātmikā / upāsyamānā saṃsārasāgarapralayānalaḥ śrīmahīkṣottare caitānadhveśān gururabravīt / brahmānantātpradhānāntaṃ viṣṇuḥ puṃsaḥ kalāntagam rudro granthau ca māyāyāmīśaḥ sādākhyagocare / anāśritaḥ śivastasmādvyāptā tadvyāpakaḥ paraḥ

[and]-:C9 śrītantrālokasya navamamāhnikam atha tattvapravibhāgo vistarataḥ kathyate kramaprāptaḥ yānyuktāni purāṇyamūni vividhaibhadairyadeṣvanvitaṃ rūpaṃ bhāti paraṃ prakāśaniviḍaṃ devaḥ sa ekaḥ śivaḥ / tatsvātantryarasātpunaḥ śivapadādbhede vibhāte paraṃ yadrūpaṃ bahudhānugāmi tadidaṃ tattvaṃ vibhoḥ śāsane tathāhi kālasadanādvīrabhadrapurāntagam / dhṛtikāṭhinyagarimādyavabhāsāddharātmatā evaṃ jalāditattveṣu vācyaṃ yāvatsadāśive / svasminkārye@tha dharmaughe yadvāpi svasadṛgguṇe āste sāmānyakalpena tananādvyāptṛbhāvataḥ / tattattvaṃ kramaśaḥ pṛthvīpradhānaṃ puṃśivādayaḥ dehānāṃ bhuvanānāṃ ca na prasaṅgastato bhavet / śrīmanmataṅgaśāstrādau taduktaṃ parameśinā tatraiṣāṃ darśyate dṛṣṭaḥ siddhayogīśvarīmate / kāryakāraṇabhāvo yaḥ śivecchāparikalpitaḥ vastutaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ karteśānaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ / asvatantrasya kartṛtvaṃ nahi jātūpapadyate svatantratā ca cinmātravapuṣaḥ parameśituḥ / svatantraṃ ca jaḍaṃ ceti tadanyonyaṃ virudhyate jāḍyaṃ pramātṛtantratvaṃ svātmasiddhimapi prati / na kartṛtvādṛte cānyat kāraṇatvaṃ hi labhyate

[and]-:C10 atha śrītantrāloke daśamamāhnikam ucyate trikaśāstrekarahasyaṃ tattvabhedanam teṣāmamīṣāṃ tattvānāṃ svavargeṣvanugāminām / bhedāntaramapi proktaṃ śāstre@tra śrītrikābhidhe śaktimacchaktibhedena dharādyaṃ mūlapaścimam / bhidyate pañcadaśadhā svarūpeṇa sahānarāt kalāntaṃ bhedayugghīnaṃ rudravatpralayākalaḥ / tadvanmāyā ca navadhā jñākalāḥ saptadhā punaḥ mantrāstadīśāḥ pāñcadhye mantreśapatayastridhā / śivo na bhidyate svaikaprakāśaghanacinmayaḥ śivo mantramaheśeśamantrā akalayukkalī / śaktimantaḥ sapta tathā śaktayastaccaturdaśa svaṃ svarūpaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tadbhūḥ pañcadaśātmikā / tathāhi tisro devasya śaktayo varṇitāḥ purā tā eva mātṛmāmeyatrairūpyeṇa vyavasthitāḥ / parāṃśo mātṛrūpo@tra pramāṇāṃśaḥ parāparaḥ meyo@paraḥ śaktimāṃśca śaktiḥ svaṃ rūpamityadaḥ / tatra svarūpaṃ bhūmeryatpṛthagjaḍamavasthitam mātṛmānādyupadhibhirasaṃjātoparāgakam / sakalādiśivāntaistu mātṛbhirvedyatāsya yā

kalādhvā vakṣyate śrīmacchāṃbhavājñānusārataḥ // 1b yathā pūrvoktabhuvanamadhye nijanijaṃ gaṇam / anuyatparato bhinnaṃ tattvaṃ nāmeti bhaṇyate tathā teṣvapi tattveṣu svavarge@nugamātmakam / vyāvṛttaṃ paravargācca kaleti śivaśāsane kecidāhuḥ punaryāsau śaktirantaḥ susūkṣmikā / tattvānāṃ sā kaletyuktā dharaṇyāṃ dhārikā yathā atra pakṣadvaye vastu na bhinnaṃ bhāsate yataḥ / anugāmi na sāmānyamiṣṭaṃ naiyāyikādivat anye vadanti dīkṣādau sukhasaṃgrahaṇārthataḥ / śivena kalpito vargaḥ kaleti samayāśrayaḥ kṛtaśca devadevena samayo@paramārthatām / na gacchatīti nāsatyo na cānyasamayodayaḥ nivṛttiḥ pṛthivītattve pratiṣṭhāvyaktagocare / vidyā niśānte śāntā ca śaktyante@ṇḍamidaṃ catuḥ śāntātītā śive tattve kalātītaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ / nahyatra vargīkaraṇaṃ samayaḥ kalanāpi vā yujyate sarvatodikkaṃ svātantryollāsadhāmani / svātantryāttu nijaṃ rūpaṃ boddhṛdharmādavicyutam

athādhvano@sya prakṛta upayogaḥ prakāśyate // 1b itthamadhvā samasto@yaṃ yathā saṃvidi saṃsthitaḥ / taddvārā śūnyadhīprāṇanāḍīcakratanuṣvatho bahiśca liṅgamūrtyagnisthaṇḍilādiṣu sarvataḥ / tathā sthitaḥ samastaśca vyastaścaiṣa kramākramāt āsaṃvittattvamābāhyaṃ yo@yamadhvā vyavasthitaḥ / tatra tatrocitaṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ svātantryeṇa bhāsayet sarvaṃ sarvatra rūpaṃ ca tasyāpi na na bhāsate / nahyavaccheditāṃ kvāpi svapne@pi viṣahāmahe evaṃ viśvādhvasaṃpūrṇaṃ kālavyāpāracitritam / deśakālamayaspandasadma dehaṃ vilokayet tathā vilokyamāno@sau viśvāntardevatāmayaḥ / dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca tarpyaśca tadāviṣṭo vimucyate itthaṃ ghaṭaṃ paṭaṃ liṅgaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ pustakaṃ jalam / yadvā kiṃcitkvacitpaśyettatra tanmayatāṃ vrajet tatrārpaṇaṃ hi vastūnāmabhedenārcanaṃ matam / tathā saṃpūrṇarūpatvānusaṃdhirdhyānamucyate

[and]-:C13 atha śrītantrāloke trayodaśamāhnikam athādhikṛtibhāhanaṃ ka iha vā kathaṃ vetyalaṃ vivecayitumucyate vividhaśaktipātakramaḥ tatra kecidiha prāhuḥ śaktipāta imaṃ vidhim / taṃ pradarśya nirākṛtya svamataṃ darśayiṣyate tatredaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ satsukhaduḥkhavimohabhāk / viṣamaṃ sattathābhūtaṃ samaṃ hetuṃ prakalpayet so@vyaktaṃ tacca sattvādinānārūpamacetanam / ghaṭādivatkāryamiti hetureko@sya sā niśā sā jaḍā kāryatādrūpyātkāryaṃ cāsyāṃ sadeva hi / kalādidharaṇīprāntaṃ jāḍyātsā sūtaye@kṣamā teneśaḥ kṣobhayedenāṃ kṣobho@syāḥ sūtiyogyatā / puṃsaḥ prati ca sā bhogyaṃ sūte@nādīn pṛthagvidhān puṃsaśca nirviśeṣatve muktāṇūn prati kiṃ na tat / nimittaṃ karmasaṃskāraḥ sa ca teṣu na vidyate iti cetkarmasaṃskārābhāvasteṣāṃ kutaḥ kila / na bhogādanyakarmāṃśaprasaṅgo hi duratyayaḥ yugapatkarmaṇāṃ bhogo naca yuktaḥ krameṇa hi / phaledyatkarma tatkasmātsvaṃ rūpaṃ saṃtyajetkvacit jñānātkarmakṣayaścettatkuta īśvaracoditāt / dharmādyadi kutaḥ so@pi karmataścettaducyatām

tirobhāvasvarūpaṃ tu kathyamānaṃ vivicyatām / svabhāvāt parameśāno niyatyaniyatikramam spṛśanprakāśate yena tataḥ svacchanda ucyate / niyatiṃ karmaphalayorāśrityaiṣa maheśvaraḥ sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānvidhatte@vāntarasthitīn / mahāsarge punaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārānantyaśālini ekaḥ sa devo viśvātmā niyatityāgataḥ prabhuḥ / avāntare yā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiścātrāpyayantritam nojjhatyeṣa vapustyaktaniyatiśca sthito@tra tat / niyatyaiva yadā caiṣa svarūpācchādanakramāt bhuṅkte duḥkhavimohādi tadā karmaphalakramaḥ / tyaktvā tu niyamaṃ kārmaṃ duḥkhamohaparītatām bibhāsayiṣurāste@yaṃ tirodhāne@napekṣakaḥ / yathā prakāśasvātantryāt pratibuddho@pyabuddhavat āste tadvadanuttīrṇo@pyuttīrṇa iva ceṣṭate / yathā ca buddhastāṃ mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ kurvannapi dviṣan hṛdyāste mūḍha evaṃ hi prabuddhānāṃ viceṣṭitam / śrīvidyādhipatiścāha mānastotre tadīdṛśam ye yauṣmāke śāsanamārge kṛtadīkṣāḥ saṃgacchanto mohavaśādvipratipattim / nūnaṃ teṣā nāsti bhavadbhānuniyogaḥ saṅkocaḥ kiṃ sūryakaraistāmarasānām

[and]-:C15 atha śrītantrāloke pañcadaśamāhnikam athaitadupayogāya yāgastāvannirūpyate / tatra dīkṣaiva bhoge ca muktau cāyātyupāyatām svayaṃ saṃskārayogādvā tadaṅgaṃ tatpradarśyate / yo yatrābhilaṣedbhogān sa tatraiva niyojitaḥ siddhibhāṅmantraśaktyeti śrīmatsvāyaṃbhuve vibhuḥ / yogyatāvaśato yatra vāsanā yasya tatra saḥ yojyo na cyavate tasmāditi śrīmālinīmate / vadanbhogādyupāyatvaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ prāha no guruḥ na cādhikāritā dīkṣāṃ vinā yoge@sti śāṅkare / na ca yogādhikāritvamekamevānayā bhavet api mantrādhikāritvaṃ muktiśca śivadīkṣayā / ityasminmālinīvākye sākṣānmokṣābhyupāyatā dīkṣāyāḥ kathitā prācyagranthena punarucyate / pāramparyeṇa saṃskṛtyā mokṣabhogābhyupāyatā yeṣāmadhyavasāyo@sti na vidyāṃ pratyaśaktitaḥ / sukhopāyamidaṃ teṣāṃ vidhānamuditaṃ guroḥ iti śrīmanmataṅgākhye hyuktā mokṣābhyupāyatā / samyagjñānasvabhāvā hi vidyā sākṣādvimocikā uktaṃ tatraiva tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvataḥ / heyādeyatvakathane vidyāpāda iti sphuṭam

[and]-:C16 atha śrītantrāloke ṣoḍaśamāhnikam atha putrakatvasiddhyai nirūpyate śivanirūpito @tra vidhiḥ / yadā tu samayasthasya putrakatve niyojanam / gurutve sādhakatve vā kartumicchati daiśikaḥ tadādhivāsaṃ kṛtvāhni dvitīye maṇḍalaṃ likhet / sāmudāyikayāge@tha tathānyatra yathoditam ṣaḍaṣṭataddviguṇitacaturviṃśatisaṃkhyayā / cakrapañcakamākhyātaṃ śāstre śrīpūrvasaṃjñite dvātriṃśattaddviguṇitaṃ śrīmattraiśirase mate / asaṃkhyacakrasaṃbandhaḥ śrīsiddhādau nirūpitaḥ tasmādyathātathā yāgaṃ yāvaccakreṇa saṃmitam / pūjayedyena tenātra triśūlatrayamālikhet triśūlatritaye devītrayaṃ paryāyavṛttitaḥ / madhyasavyānyabhedena pūrṇaṃ saṃpūjitaṃ bhavet vartanā maṇḍalasyāgre saṃkṣepādupadekṣyate / ālikhya maṇḍalaṃ gandhavastreṇaivāsya mārjanam kṛtvā snāto guruḥ prāgvanmaṇḍalāgre@tra devatāḥ / bāhyagāḥ pūjayeddvāradeśe ca dvāradevatāḥ maṇḍalasya purobhāge tadaiśānadiśaḥ kramāt / āgneyyantaṃ gaṇeśādīn kṣetrapāntānprapūjayet gaṇapatiguruparamākhyāḥ parameṣṭhī pūrvasiddhavākkṣetrapatiḥ / iti saptakamākhyātaṃ gurupaṅktividhau prapūjyamasmadgurubhiḥ

saivaṃ bhūtātmanā svenāpy alabdhapariniṣṭhitiḥ katham anyasya bhāvasya pratiṣṭhāspadatām iyāt idam ity ucitaḥ saṃvit prakāśe 'nyasya vastunaḥ pratiṣṭhātmakatāṃ gacched aham ity ātmanā punaḥ vyatireketarābhyām hi niścayo 'nyajaḍātmanoḥ vyavasthitiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca siddhir nirvṛttir ucyate evam ātmany asatkalpāḥ prakāśasyaiva santy amī jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti svātmanaḥ svaparātmabhiḥ na caivānubhavo 'py asti bhinnābhinnaviniścayam muktvānvayasya prakāśasya vimarśarahitātmanaḥ idam ity asya vicchinnavimarśasya kṛtārthatā yā svasvarūpe viśrāntir vimarśaḥ so 'ham ity ayam dvidhā sa eṣa evātmā mito 'parimitas tathā prāṇādinā niruddho 'ṇuḥ paramātmā tv akhaṇḍitaḥ ubhayo 'py eṣa paryantabhūmiḥ sarvārthasaṃvidām eka evānusandhānād ato 'nyo nopapadyate na cāpy avyatirekātmavimarśātmany ahaṃvidi bhāti paryantavartinyāṃ bhāsanād adhikaṃ jaḍam

na siddho 'prathanād eva jñānādisamavāyy api tat prāṇādi prameyaṃ syān na pramātānyato bhramāt yady apy arthasthitiḥ prāṇapuryaṣṭakaniyantrite jīve niruddhā tatrāpi paramātmani sā sthitā tadātmanaiva tasya syāt kathaṃ prāṇena yantraṇā sādhitā pratyabhijñāyām akhyāter jīvatā param nārthavyavasthā prāṇādāv ahaṃbhāvanirodhataḥ prakāśasyātmaviśrāntir ahaṃbhāvo hi kīrtitaḥ uktā saiva ca viśrāntiḥ sarvāpekṣānirodhataḥ svātantryam atha kartṛtvaṃ mukhyam īśvaratāpi ca māyābhidās tacchakter eva cānyāprasiddhitaḥ tadakhyātimayaṃ hy etaj jagannirmātṛteśitā ekaiva cānusaṃdhānāt sā proktā sarvasaṃvidām svasaṃvedanaparyāyamātṛtattvam anādi tat bhāvavyavasthā yan niṣṭhā tasyāhaṃbhāvabhāginaḥ vyāpitvam anusaṃdhānaṃ taj jaḍasya na yujyate tato bhede tu bhāsasya ghaṭate bhāsamānatā tenoktam pratyabhijñāyāṃ tadadvayamayaṃ jagat

ardhoddhāṭitalocanaḥ sthiramanā nāsāgradattekṣaṇaḥ candrārkāvapi līnatāmupagatau trispandabhāvāntare | jyotīrūpamaśeṣabāhyarahitaṃ caikaṃ pumāṃsaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tatpadameti vastu paramam vācyaṃ kimatrādhikam

śabdaḥ kaścana yo mukhādudayate mantraḥ sa lokottaraḥ saṃsthānaṃ sukhaduḥkhajanmavapuṣo yatkāpi mudraiva sā | prāṇasya svarasena yatpravahaṇaṃ yogaḥ sa evādbhutaḥ śāktaṃ dhāma paraṃ mamānubhavataḥ kinnāma na bhrājate

mantraḥ sa pratibhāti varṇaracanā yasminna saṃlakṣyate mudrā sā samudeti yatra galitā kṛtsnā kriyā kāyikī | yogaḥ sa prathate yataḥ pravahaṇaṃ prāṇasya saṃkṣīyate tvaddhāmādhigamotsaveṣu sudhiyāṃ kiṃ kiṃ na nāmādbhutaṃ

saṃsāro 'sti na tattvatas tanubhṛtāṃ bandhasya vārtaiva kā bandho yasya na jātu tasya vitathā muktasya muktikriyā | mithyāmohakṛd eṣa rajjubhujagacchāyāpiśācabhramo mā kiṃcit tyaja mā gṛhāṇa vihara svastho yathāvasthitaḥ

pūjapūjakapūjyabhedasaraṇiḥ keyaṃ kathānuttare saṃkrāmaḥ kila kasya kena vidadhe ko vā praveśakramaḥ | māyeyam na cidadvayāt paratayā bhinnāpy aho vartate sarvaṃ svānubhavasvabhāvavimalaṃ cintāṃ vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ

ānando 'tra na vittamadhyamadavan naivāṅganāsaṅgavat dīpārkendukṛtaprabhāprakaravan naiva prakāśodayaḥ | harṣaḥ saṃbhṛtabhedamuktisukhabhūr bhārāvatāropamaḥ sarvādvaitapadasya vismṛtanidheḥ prāptiḥ prakāśodayaḥ
